name: agent-guide
body: Agent guide: the embedded author-guide content and its verbatim write for all three scaffolding forms — the deck-root full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` plus its `AGENTS.md` pointer, written by `kalide init` and `kalide init <path>` (agent-authoring, agent-guide-reference), and the library-root full guide plus its pointer, written by `kalide init-library` (library-agent-guide, library-guide-layout). The `AGENTS.md` pointer is written per the reference rule (created, left untouched, or appended to); the full guide is written only when absent. Realised by the scaffold package's embedded guide files and writers (internal/scaffold) — Init, writeHelloSeed, InitExternal and InitLibrary — and announced by the CLI handlers (internal/cli). The build/test-time drift self-test (agent-guide-drift-check) guards both full guides and the pointer content.
